name: Fanvault
tagline: Run your creator storefront through AI
description: Manage a Fanvault creator storefront through Cline. Create listings and digital products, publish and schedule content, fulfill orders, review analytics, and handle buyer messages using Fanvault's hosted MCP server.

install.notes: Requires a Fanvault creator account. Authenticate through OAuth when prompted, or configure a scoped personal access token from Fanvault Settings > MCP.
